Expected change site: .github/workflows/review_autofix.yml line 1500 (the AUTOFIX_GATE_DET_SKIP_EVAL echo statement).
Evidence of absence: The AUTOFIX_GATE_DET_SKIP_EVAL echo in the diff lacks the claude_handoff_suppressed flag, preventing operators and log-scraping tools from distinguishing between "diff didn't qualify for skip" and "handoff guard suppressed the skip" when skip=false.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
Requirement: "the fail-closed comment lookup" (PR description "Test plan", changelog.d/4609-claude-pr-deterministic-skip.md "For contributors" line 16, agents.md lines 99-100: "a failed comment lookup logs reason=claude_fixer_handoff_unverified and also runs it"). The new test `test_gate_claude_pr_skip_fails_closed_when_the_handoff_lookup_fails` is supposed to verify that a failed comment lookup on the deterministic-skip path logs `reason=claude_fixer_handoff_unverified` and suppresses the skip. The PR description's "40 passed" claim includes this test by count.
Expected change site: tests/test_review_autofix_claude_fixer_mode.py — the `GATE_MOCK_GH` mock at lines 467-494 and/or `_run_gate` at line 497. Specifically the `/comments` branch at lines 486-487 needs a `comments_fail` simulation flag (mirroring the existing `files_fail` flag on line 489 and the `comments_fail` flag in tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py lines 2167-2169).
Evidence of absence: At tests/test_review_autofix_claude_fixer_mode.py:649, the new test passes `comments=None` to `_run_gate`. Tracing the path:
- `_run_gate` at line 506 guards `None if comments is None else` and writes `"comments": None` into the state file.
- `GATE_MOCK_GH` at lines 486-487 emits `state["comments"]` (i.e., JSON `null`) for any `/comments` request.
- The workflow calls `gate_fetch_marker_comments` at review_autofix.yml:708-712, which pipes the mock's output through an inner `--jq '[.[] | ...]'` filter. On null input, `[.[] | ...]` produces `[]`, so the mock writes `[]\n` to stdout.
- The outer `jq -c -s 'add // []'` (review_autofix.yml:711) wraps `[]` into `[[]]` and `add` flattens it back to `[]\n`.
- `[ -s "${gate_marker_comments_file}" ]` at review_autofix.yml:712 evaluates true (the file contains `[]\n`, two bytes), so `gate_marker_fetch_state="ok"` is set.
- The new guard at review_autofix.yml:1488 checks `[ "${gate_marker_fetch_state}" != "ok" ] || ! [[ "${pr_head_sha_gate}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]` — both branches are false, so `CLAUDE_HANDOFF_SKIP_SUPPRESSED` stays `"false"` and no `AUTOFIX_GATE_DET_SKIP_SUPPRESSED reason=claude_fixer_handoff_unverified` line is logged.
- `gate_claude_handoff_on_head` (review_autofix.yml:726-733) runs `any(.[]; ...)` on the empty `[]` file, returns false (exit 1), the `elif` branch at line 1491 is skipped, the final check at line 1497-1506 sees all suppressions false and sets `DETERMINISTIC_SKIP="true"`, `SHOULD_RUN="false"`.
- The test then asserts (lines 651-653):
  - `AUTOFIX_GATE_DET_SKIP_SUPPRESSED reason=claude_fixer_handoff_unverified pr=42 in proc.stdout` — false, the line never emits.
  - `out["deterministic_skip"] == "false"` — false, the skip proceeded and `"true"` is recorded.
  - `out["should_run"] == "true"` — false, the skip set `"should_run"` to `"false"`.
The mock at lines 486-487 has no `if data.get("comments_fail"): sys.exit(1)` analogue of the `files_fail` branch on line 489; `tests/test_workflow_failure_heal.py` shows the established pattern (lines 2167-2169). Without the flag the test cannot drive `gate_marker_fetch_state` to anything other than `"ok"`, so the `claude_fixer_handoff_unverified` branch at review_autofix.yml:1488-1490 is unreachable from this test. The pre-existing `test_gate_rejects_failed_comment_fetch` at line 726 also passes `comments=None` but does not depend on a non-"ok" fetch state — it asserts `claude_fixer_verify == "false"` and `should_run == "false"` purely from the convergence-gate logic at review_autofix.yml:769-811, so the broken mock is not surfaced there.
SEVERITY: MAJOR
ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
